message: You had me going Mike. Until I read the first bit I didn't realize you were writing fiction, and I didn't think you wanted to delve so deeply into the realities of your work-a-day world, not that it's particularly work-a-day. That you had me going, in a good way mind you, bodes well. I sense a thriller in the making, one I could never pull out of my present institution, that's for sure.
